settings.heading: Designed around real rooms, not showrooms
settings.text: Table Buddy started with a simple frustration: most surfaces in a home are fixed in place, but life isn't. We build one adjustable table that moves between the sofa, the bed, the desk and the deck — so you don't need four different pieces of furniture for four different moments.

settings.heading: Every Table Buddy is built to the same standard

settings.title: Genuinely no-tool setup
settings.text: If it needs a manual, we haven't finished the job.

settings.title: Built for Australian homes
settings.text: Compact, lightweight and sized for apartments as much as houses.

settings.title: Adjustable, always
settings.text: Six heights and three angles on every model — no exceptions.

settings.quote: I work from the couch three days a week now. Six height settings means it's perfect for my laptop and my lunch plate.
settings.author: Sarah T.

settings.quote: Folds completely flat and slides behind the couch. Genuinely space-saving for my tiny apartment.
settings.author: Josh L.
